name: Movie Room Master

sourceOfTruth.label: Movie Room Master repository
sourceOfTruth.rule: GitHub stores source control, application modules, deployment configuration, generated inventories, and recovery instructions. The movie library and private credentials stay outside Git.

paths.applicationArtifactsPolicy: Installable APKs and release artifacts are copied to the configured applicationsRoot from the ignored local library config, not stored as large generated media in Git.

animationBuckets.policy: Store generated Runway, bucket, tile, menu, and app animation binaries in object storage. Store only URLs, hashes, durations, variants, ownership, profile targeting, and catalog pointers in SQL or a lightweight catalog.
animationBuckets.costControl: Use cached generated assets and app-side local caching before running new billable generations.

verificationGates: Run the Node test suite before claiming the web app is ready.
Build Android, Fire TV, and shell APK modules before publishing APK artifacts.
Verify the production Vercel URL after deployment.
Keep credentials, refresh tokens, API keys, cookies, and private local movie paths out of Git.
